channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, LatAm, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, LatAm, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new residency - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Instituto Sacatar: Sacatar Fellowship 2027 (Bahia, Brazil)
    https://sacatar.org/en/fellowships/
    Instituto Sacatar · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Fully hosted residency: private bedroom with attached bathroom, three meals a day (except Saturday evenings, Sundays and Brazilian holidays), an individual studio suited to the discipline, weekly laundry, logistical support and airport transfer from Salvador. NO STIPEND, no airfare and no materials budget. USD 25 application fee. One French artist may additionally receive airfare and a stipend through Villa Fatumbi.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
